Keyboard Shortcuts

 Updated May 22, 2026 16:25

 Our beautiful calculators have many keyboard shortcuts to improve efficiency. Many of these operations and functions can be easily accessed on the keyboards embedded in our calculators, but you may find knowing the key stroke shortcuts to your most commonly used features really enhances your Desmos experience.
